admin.operations.match_stats.tba_stats_e.zh: TBA，BP 结束后可录入数据
admin.operations.match_stats.tba_stats_e.en: TBA. Stats entry unlocks after the map veto completes.

admin.operations.matches.delete_this_mat.zh: 确定删除比赛吗？相关统计、直播记录和评论也会一起删除。
admin.operations.matches.delete_this_mat.en: Delete this match? Its statistics, live records and comments will also be deleted.

admin.operations.matches.no_matches_foun.zh: 没有找到符合条件的比赛

admin.operations.matches.reopen_this_mat.zh: 确定重新开启这场比赛吗？

admin.operations.matches.search_teams_ev.zh: 搜索队伍名 / 赛事 / ID

admin.operations.matches_form.adjust_or_.zh: 去「报名与阵容」页调整或赛前换人 →
admin.operations.matches_form.adjust_or_.en: Adjust or swap players on Registration & Rosters →

admin.operations.matches_form.all_ten_pl.zh: 本场双方十人已记录为只读状态，可以继续进行 BP。注意：冻结本场阵容只记录参赛名单，不表示选手已到场或比赛已开始。
admin.operations.matches_form.all_ten_pl.en: All ten players are recorded (read-only) and the match is ready for Map Veto. Note: locking only records the lineup and does not mean players are present or the match has started.

admin.operations.matches_form.clear_shar.zh: 清除现有 BP 共享口令

admin.operations.matches_form.confirm_in.zh: 去报名与阵容确认首五

admin.operations.matches_form.entrant_ev.zh: 参赛身份 #{event_entrant_id} · 当前阵容

admin.operations.matches_form.event_cann.zh: 托管比赛所属赛事不可更换。
admin.operations.matches_form.event_cann.en: Event cannot be changed for a managed match.

admin.operations.matches_form.if_no_onli.zh: 若未进行在线 BP，可在此手动记录各回合 Ban/Pick 流程（每行一步）
admin.operations.matches_form.if_no_onli.en: If no online veto was used, record each step manually (one per line)

admin.operations.matches_form.initial_ro.zh: 尚未在「报名与阵容」页确认初始五人。
admin.operations.matches_form.initial_ro.en: Initial Roster not confirmed yet on Registration & Rosters.

admin.operations.matches_form.later_curr.zh: 本届当前阵容之后若有变动，不会改写本场已冻结名单。
admin.operations.matches_form.later_curr.en: Later Current Roster changes will not overwrite this locked Match Roster.

admin.operations.matches_form.leave_blan.en: Leave blank to keep the current passcode

admin.operations.matches_form.locking_ca.zh: 冻结后将把当前双方的五人名单、队名与队标固定到本场比赛，之后才能开始 BP，且本场不可重新冻结。冻结只记录本场参赛名单，不表示选手已到场或比赛已开始。
admin.operations.matches_form.locking_ca.en: Locking captures both 5-player lineups, names, and logos for this match before Map Veto and cannot be redone. Note: locking only records the lineup and does not mean players are present or the match has started.

admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.zh: 托管比赛请前往“比赛运营”办理开赛授权与开局
admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.en: Managed match: open Match operations to authorize and start runs

admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.zh: 托管比赛请前往“比赛运营”确认赛果并正式完赛
admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.en: Managed match: open Match operations to confirm results and settle

admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.zh: 托管比赛状态由比赛运营流转，此处不可直接切换
admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.en: Managed match status is controlled in Match operations

admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.zh: 新流程托管比赛：此处仅负责赛前配置、本场阵容冻结与 BP；开赛授权、实际开局、技术重赛、Demo 采纳、正式赛果、结算与统计修订请前往“比赛运营”。
admin.operations.matches_form.managed_ma.en: Managed match: use this page for pre-match setup, Match Roster locking, and Map Veto. Use Match operations for start authorization, map runs, technical rematches, demos, official results, settlement, and stats revisions.

admin.operations.matches_form.match_fini.zh: 比赛已结束：比分为直播记录，可补充 Ban/Pick 流程、直播和观赛链接。若非录入失误请勿切回“未开始”，以免统计数据产生混乱。
admin.operations.matches_form.match_fini.en: Match finished: the score comes from the live record. You can add the Ban/Pick log, stream and watch links. Do not switch back to “Upcoming” unless it was set by mistake, or the stats may get mixed up.

admin.operations.matches_form.match_in_p.zh: 比赛进行中：赛事、时间、赛制、地图和比分已锁定，比分只由数据直播更新。
admin.operations.matches_form.match_in_p.en: Match in progress: event, time, format, maps and score are locked; the score is only updated by live data.

admin.operations.matches_form.matchup_li.zh: 对阵双方（已绑定本届参赛队）

admin.operations.matches_form.no_entrant.zh: 未绑定第 {side_num} 方参赛队
本届还没有确认初始五人的参赛队伍，暂时无法建立比赛。
admin.operations.matches_form.no_entrant.en: No entrants have confirmed Initial Rosters yet; matches cannot be created.

admin.operations.matches_form.no_players.zh: 暂无可选选手，请先完善队伍或替补报名资料。
admin.operations.matches_form.no_players.en: No players available. Complete team or substitute registration first.

admin.operations.matches_form.not_locked.zh: 尚未冻结。点击上方「确认冻结本场阵容」后，将按上方「本届当前阵容」的五人记录到本场比赛。
admin.operations.matches_form.not_locked.en: Not locked yet. Click "Lock Match Roster" above to record both Current Rosters for this match.

admin.operations.matches_form.password_p.zh: password 密码;connect 服务器IP:端口

admin.operations.matches_form.paste_a_tg.zh: 可直接粘贴 TGPro / connect 字符串。含口令，不会存进草稿。
admin.operations.matches_form.paste_a_tg.en: Paste a TGPro / connect command. It may contain a password and is not saved in drafts.

admin.operations.matches_form.pre_match_.zh: 赛前设置可以修改；比分由数据直播自动同步。
admin.operations.matches_form.pre_match_.en: Pre-match settings can be edited; scores sync automatically from the live feed.

admin.operations.matches_form.registered.zh: 默认使用战队报名名单；有人缺席时在对应位置换成已报名的替补，保存后网站和导播软件用同一份名单。
admin.operations.matches_form.registered.en: Registered team rosters are used by default. Replace an absent player with a registered substitute; the saved roster is shared by the site and director.

admin.operations.matches_form.resolve_th.zh: 冻结前检查发现以下问题（解决后才能冻结成功）：
admin.operations.matches_form.resolve_th.en: Resolve these blockers before locking the Match Roster:

admin.operations.matches_form.rostered_p.zh: 名单内选手验证口令后申请本队操作席；BP 由选手或管理员手动开始。口令不会存进草稿。
admin.operations.matches_form.rostered_p.en: Rostered players verify the passcode to claim their team's veto seat. Players or admins start the veto manually. Not saved in drafts.

admin.operations.matches_form.set_shared.zh: 设置 BP 共享口令（可留空）

admin.operations.matches_form.shared_onl.zh: 在线选边 (BP) 共享口令

admin.operations.matches_form.shown_on_t.zh: 前台显示为可点击的平台按钮。
admin.operations.matches_form.shown_on_t.en: Shown on the public page as a clickable platform button.

admin.operations.matches_form.sides_are_.zh: 比赛建立后双方已固定，不能互换或改绑；需要冻结本场五人请切到「本场阵容」页签。
admin.operations.matches_form.sides_are_.en: Sides are fixed once created and cannot be swapped. Switch to the "Match Roster" tab to lock lineups for this match.

admin.operations.matches_form.starting_c.zh: 开局 CT / T 以 BP 结果为准
admin.operations.matches_form.starting_c.en: Starting CT / T sides follow the map veto result

admin.operations.matches_form.teams_are_.zh: 参赛方可留空，或每边选 1–5 名测试选手。
admin.operations.matches_form.teams_are_.en: Teams are optional, or select 1–5 test players per side.

admin.operations.matches_form.teams_lock.zh: 参赛队伍（比赛开始后已锁定）

admin.operations.matches_form.this_is_a_.zh: 这是一场测试比赛，不要求填写参赛队伍或选手。
admin.operations.matches_form.this_is_a_.en: This is a test match; teams and players are optional.

admin.operations.matches_form.this_match.zh: 比赛已取消：只能修改状态、直播链接和观赛信息。
admin.operations.matches_form.this_match.en: This match was cancelled. Only its status, stream links, and viewing information can be changed.

admin.operations.matches_form.use_one_gr.zh: 本届只能有一场总决赛，且不能连接下游席位。
admin.operations.matches_form.use_one_gr.en: Use one grand final, with no outgoing bracket links.

admin.operations.participation_dialogs.e.zh: 例如：管理员现场核对首回合上场
admin.operations.participation_dialogs.e.en: e.g. Verified player active in round 1

admin.operations.participation_dialogs.e.zh: 说明撤回或恢复出场记录的原因
admin.operations.participation_dialogs.e.en: Explain why participation is being withdrawn or restored

admin.operations.participation_dialogs.s.zh: 选择本局实际出场的选手
admin.operations.participation_dialogs.s.en: Select the players who played in this map run

admin.operations.participation_dialogs.s.zh: 回合阵营（填回合号时可选）

admin.operations.result_panel.clearly_se.zh: 严格区分直播实时比分、Demo 候选比分与管理员确认的正式赛果
admin.operations.result_panel.clearly_se.en: Clearly separated from live scorebot feeds and demo candidate scores

admin.operations.result_panel.full_versi.zh: 按版本号保留每一次修改与撤销历史
admin.operations.result_panel.full_versi.en: Full versioned history of every decision and override

admin.operations.result_panel.official_m.zh: 单图正式赛果（Official Map Results）

admin.operations.result_panel.result_bra.zh: 赛果、签表与结算审计记录

admin.operations.result_panel.series_set.zh: 系列赛结算与下游联动（Series Settlement）

admin.operations.run_dialogs.e_g_verifie.zh: 例如：管理员核对首回合服务器已开打、双方十人已就位
admin.operations.run_dialogs.e_g_verifie.en: e.g. Verified pistol round live on server with all 10 players connected

admin.operations.run_dialogs.explain_how.zh: 说明如何核对该导播会话对应此次实际开局
admin.operations.run_dialogs.explain_how.en: Explain how this director session was verified for this map run

admin.operations.run_dialogs.restarting_.zh: 用相同配置重启导播不会产生新会话。请核对新的会话编号和实际开局。
admin.operations.run_dialogs.restarting_.en: Restarting the director with the same settings does not create a new session. Verify the new session ID and map run.

admin.operations.run_panel.locked_roster.zh: 冻结阵容仅代表本场批准资格，不等同于单局实际出场
admin.operations.run_panel.locked_roster.en: Locked roster defines eligibility only, not actual map participation

admin.operations.run_panel.match_roster_.zh: 本场固定阵容（Match Roster · 只读）

admin.operations.run_panel.scheduled_map.zh: 排定赛图与实际开局（Scheduled Maps

admin.operations.run_panel.void_runs_rem.zh: 作废局保留审计留档，不计入正式赛果与统计
admin.operations.run_panel.void_runs_rem.en: Void runs remain archived for audit and do not count toward official results or stats

admin.operations.series_result_dialog.en.zh: 填写本次结算或重开说明
admin.operations.series_result_dialog.en.en: Enter the reason for settling or reopening

admin.operations.series_result_dialog.re.zh: 核对最新裁定，保留输入
admin.operations.series_result_dialog.re.en: Review latest result without discarding edits

admin.operations.stat_revision_panel.0_i.zh: 规则说明：0 表示真实零值，留空 / - 表示未知；系统不会自动把未知填成 0。保存时仅提交你实际改动的字段，且版本号按整局（all / ct / t 共享）校验。
admin.operations.stat_revision_panel.0_i.en: 0 is a true zero and blank / - means unknown (unknowns are never filled as 0). Only touched fields are submitted, checked against the run-wide revision shared across all/ct/t.

admin.operations.stat_revision_panel.rev.zh: 按开局 / 选手 / 阵营修订统计字段
admin.operations.stat_revision_panel.rev.en: Revise player stats by run, player & side

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.appr.zh: 批准技术重赛会将当前局次标记为
admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.appr.en: Approving a technical rematch marks the current run as

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.clea.zh: ，清除其站内直播画面；若该图已有正式赛果或本场已结算，将同步撤销原裁定。原局与录像仍保留供审计查看。
admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.clea.en: , clearing it from Scorebot. Any official result for the map or settlement for the match is revoked. The original run and its Demo remain available for review.

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.e_g_.zh: 例如：第 8 回合服务器崩服且无法恢复备份，经双方队长确认重赛
admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.e_g_.en: e.g. Server crashed on round 8 with no recoverable backup; captains confirmed rematch

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.incl.zh: 同时办理技术替补（换入已获该队替补席的候补选手，且后续赛图继续沿用）
admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.incl.en: Include a technical substitute (assigned team reserve; carries over to subsequent maps)

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.inco.zh: 换入替补（该队已分配候补席）

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.outg.zh: 换出选手（当前有效阵容）

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.revi.zh: 核对最新裁定，保留输入
admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.revi.en: Review latest result without discarding edits

admin.operations.tech_replay_dialog.tech.zh: 故障与无法原局继续的原因（必填）
